competitions_dates.name: competitions_dates
competitions_dates.value: "competitions"."ends_on" IS NULL OR "competitions"."starts_on" IS NULL OR "competitions"."ends_on" >= "competitions"."starts_on"

matches_distinct_players.name: matches_distinct_players
matches_distinct_players.value: "matches"."player1_id" IS NULL OR "matches"."player2_id" IS NULL OR "matches"."player1_id" <> "matches"."player2_id"

matches_completed_has_winner.name: matches_completed_has_winner
matches_completed_has_winner.value: "matches"."status" NOT IN ('completed','walkover') OR "matches"."winner_id" IS NOT NULL

points_sides.name: points_sides
points_sides.value: "points"."winner_side" IN (1,2) AND ("points"."server_side" IS NULL OR "points"."server_side" IN (1,2))
